data.title: we’ll establish a co-operative farmer’s council
data.promise_blog:
President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has pledged to establish a Co-operative Farmers' Council as part of his administration's broader strategy to enhance agricultural productivity, ensure food security, and empower rural communities.This initiative aims to provide farmers with a unified platform to access resources, share knowledge, and influence agricultural policies.

While the formal establishment of the Co-operative Farmers' Council is  not forthcoming, the Tinubu administration has already undertaken several measures to strengthen the cooperative movement and support farmers nationwide.

updates.blog:
FG and NIMC Introduce Digital Farmer Registry for Improved Resource Distribution

In collaboration with the National Identity Management Commission (NIMC), the Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security has launched a NIN-enabled farmer registry.This digital registry is designed to modernise the agricultural sector by providing farmers with unique identification numbers, facilitating access to government programs, subsidies, and financial services.The initiative aims to create a comprehensive database of farmers, enhancing transparency and efficiency in the distribution of resources.

Though, the government has launched an identity-based registry which can act as a backbone for any data-driven intervention from the government, the absence of the promised co-operative farmer's council still leaves more to be desired and the promise is far from being fulfilled.

This promise is rated In The Works.
